package.name: Finco1 Current Product Scope Snapshot after UI + Generic Loop

what_app_currently_does: Run / save / load of scenario runs.
Runtime What Changed Delta Indicator (UI + minimal metadata-persistence rotation, Phase 25B-3 / PR #586).
Scenario version history with rotation (replay_metadata.previous_run_summary, second_last_run_summary, previous_run_at).
Runtime summary, validation summary, banner context wiring (Phase 55E-55G).
CAPEX summary grid rendered via the shared LineItemGrid partial/macro (Phase 57A / PR #487).
Route-render smoke + index context-contract tests (Phase 57-pre / PR #486).
UX cleanup closeout and visual review pack (Phase 56G / PR #484).
what_is_model_backed: Revenue, OPEX, EBITDA, CAPEX, Distributions, Senior Debt (kEUR).
All factory / reference project scenarios (TUHO, Oborovo).
Factory project run summary output is byte-identical to pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
Parity-core lock is preserved for TUHO and Oborovo.
what_is_ui_backed_only: What Changed panel (subtraction + percentage on existing run summary data).
Scenario compare (side-by-side view of existing run summaries).
what_is_governance_backed_only: No-go claim list (B1, B11, B19, B22, B38, B44).
Scenario compare / export / download evidence register (B46).
what_is_explicitly_not_validated: Generic Solar is not Excel-parity validated against a reference solar model.
Generic Wind is not Excel-parity validated against a reference wind model.
Generic Solar / Wind defaults are not market-validated assumptions.
No reference solar model is available for Generic Solar output validation.
No reference wind model is available for Generic Wind output validation.
No controlled pilot run with real users has occurred.
No user visual review of the What Changed panel, the compare panel, the multi-compare picker, or the export / download pack has been performed.
No paid pilot has been authorized.
No customer reference has been made.
current_ui_capabilities: Index page with runtime summary, validation summary, and banner context.
Inputs tab with per-scenario input editing.
What Changed panel (read-only UI panel; 10 KPIs).
current_generic_solar_wind_capabilities: Export / download pack (internal artifact generation; exploratory banner required).
What Changed panel (read-only UI panel; 10 KPIs; exploratory banner required).
current_scenario_workflow: View the runtime summary, validation summary, and banner context.
View the What Changed deltas (if at least 2 runs; for Generic Solar / Wind, the exploratory banner is required).
Export / download the scenario artifacts (for Generic scenarios; exploratory banner required).
current_compare_export_download_workflow: Compare is a side-by-side view of existing run summaries. Compare is internal functionality, not model validation.
Export / download pack is internal artifact generation, not bankability.
current_what_changed_workflow: Edit a scenario, save it, run it.
Edit the scenario again, save it, run it again.
View the What Changed deltas (10 KPIs).
For generic_solar / generic_wind, the exploratory banner is required.
The panel is gated on card.is_user_project; factory projects do not render the panel.
The factory project run summary output is byte-identical to the pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
current_persistence_saved_scenario_state: Scenario run summaries are persisted via last_run_summary_json.
replay_metadata is persisted. The replay_metadata JSON column now carries two additional optional keys (previous_run_summary, second_last_run_summary) plus an ISO timestamp (previous_run_at).
The persistence rotation in update_scenario_last_run_summary is minimal and scoped.
Other replay_metadata keys are preserved across writes.
current_factory_reference_project_state: TUHO and Oborovo are the canonical reference projects.
Factory project run summary output is byte-identical to pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
What Changed panel does not render for factory projects (TUHO / Oborovo).
Parity-core lock is preserved for TUHO and Oborovo.

distinctions_must_be_maintained.tuho_oborovo: reference or factory flows. Factory output is byte-identical. What Changed panel does not render.
distinctions_must_be_maintained.generic_solar_wind: exploratory flows. Exploratory banner is required. Deltas are explanatory, not guaranteed accuracy claims.
distinctions_must_be_maintained.internal_evidence: evidence that is collected internally (e.g., automated tests, internal documentation, internal review).
distinctions_must_be_maintained.external_validation: separate workstream. External validation has not occurred.
distinctions_must_be_maintained.internal_pilot_readiness: readiness of the internal controlled pilot. Does not equal paid pilot readiness.
distinctions_must_be_maintained.paid_pilot_readiness: readiness of the paid pilot. Paid pilot is not authorized.
distinctions_must_be_maintained.enterprise_saas_readiness: readiness of the enterprise SaaS rollout. Enterprise SaaS readiness is not claimed.

global_notes: The snapshot describes the current state of the product at the time of B48 authoring. It is not approval. It is not external validation. It is not bankability. It is not a paid pilot authorization.
Internal pilot readiness does not equal paid pilot readiness. External reviewer evidence index does not equal external validation.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
